svg.title: services-dns — Loom control center
svg.text: Manage exact .loom records; names and answers never grant device access.
Search a private name or address
control.loom is derived from authenticated serving Web entries and cannot be edited here.
The answer is inside a mapped LAN. Actual access still requires office-lan.
Missing DNS measurements stay unknown even when the signed record is effective.
Only exact .loom A / AAAA records are supported. No wildcard or public-domain override.
Must end in .loom; control.loom is reserved.
This update changes name resolution only.
It does not add a Policy grant or prove reachability.
The receiving control returns local acceptance.
Peer propagation is shown after the response.
